incident-bot: Pager: HIGH disk usage on model-serving nodes (nodegroup: inference-pool-3). Several pods entering Evicted/OOMKilled state. Automations notified oncall.

alex: saw the pager, jumping in. which namespace?

priya: namespace=redwood-serve. kubectl shows multiple modelcache pods evicted on node inference-03.

samir: logs show a lot of writeback churn from model-cache + a sudden log growth from /var/log/serve/runtime.log. suspect runaway checkpoint writes.

irene: I can run a quick du on the node, alex can you ssh?

alex: on it. ssh inference-03 -> sudo du -sh /var/lib/modelcache /var/log/serve /tmp || true

```
/var/lib/modelcache  134G
/var/log/serve       92G
/tmp                 200M
```

alex: node root partition at 97% used. kubelet eviction triggered. several pods got Evicted.

priya: stack traces from one runtime pod (model-runner-5):

```
[ERROR] CudaError: device memory allocation failed
[ERROR] Runtime exiting due to OOM
```

priya: so both disk pressure causing evictions and some containers reporting GPU mem issues on restart (maybe degraded due to partial restore).

samir: for immediate mitigation: 1) stop logging to file (rotate + compress), 2) remove stale model checkpoints, 3) cordon node so we don't schedule more heavy pods.

irene: I'll run log rotate script and compress old logs. running:

```
ssh inference-03 'sudo systemctl stop serve-logger && sudo gzip /var/log/serve/*.log.1 && sudo rm -f /var/log/serve/*.old'
```

alex: cordoning node now: kubectl cordon inference-03 :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Notice: 3 pods in redwood-serve were evicted: model-cache-5, model-runner-9, http-proxy-2.

priya: while logs compressed freed ~70G, modelcache dir still 134G. any large files there?

irene: listing top files:

```
sudo find /var/lib/modelcache -type f -printf '%s %p\n' | sort -nr | head -n 20
```
returned a bunch of large shard files and older checkpoints (many >10GB).

samir: we have a policy to keep last 3 checkpoints; looks like retention didn't prune. maybe background GC crashed. I'll run GC to remove older checkpoints (dry-run first).

samir: dry-run shows ~80GB reclaimable. scheduling GC now.

alex: Oncall handoff: priya, you good to own until infra confirms node health?

priya: taking it. I'll also open a PagerDuty incident and update customer impact.

priya: status update -> impact: about 12% of in-flight requests for the last 5min returned 5xx from model-runner pods that were restarted/evicted. Fallback to smaller model variant happened for some routes, but end-to-end latency increased for others. Notifying customers on SLA slack.

oncall: I'm the scheduled oncall, joining. summary pls.

priya: welcome. root cause: node disk filled by runaway logging + stale model checkpoints causing kubelet to evict pods. side effect: some model-runner restarts hit GPU allocation failures (CUDA OOM) during warmup. mitigation actions: cordoned node, compressed logs (~70G freed), GC removed old checkpoints (~80G freed), restarted kubelet, draining remaining non-critical pods.

oncall: good. next steps: uncordon only after node passes disk pressure checks and kubelet stable for 5m. consider increasing node ephemeral volume or move modelcache to larger volume on the node pool template.

samir: agree. I'll file a change to adjust modelcache GC cron so it can't overlap with heavy writes and add guardrails to cap checkpoint retention to 3 and alert at 60% disk.

irene: also adding log rotation to run every 15m during high-write windows, and a temp kill-switch to redirect debug logs to stdout so they don't pile on disk.

alex: customers impacted list (prod): customer-a high QPS with pinned large models; customer-b minor errors due to fallback; internal infra telemetry showed spikes in 5xxs for route /v1/generate.

priya: posted incident note to incident channel and opened a support ticket to customers with mitigation summary.

deploy-bot: Rollback not necessary. No recent model deployment coincident with spike.

oncall: can you paste the commands used to free space for runbook?

irene: runbook snippet:

```
# compress logs
sudo systemctl stop serve-logger
sudo gzip /var/log/serve/*.log
# prune checkpoints (modelcache GC)
/opt/redwood/bin/modelcache_gc --dry-run --keep 3
/opt/redwood/bin/modelcache_gc --execute --keep 3
# verify disk
df -h /
# restart kubelet
sudo systemctl restart kubelet
```

priya: monitoring: disk% dropped to 62% after GC+compress. kubelet eviction thresholds no longer triggered. model-runner pods restarted successfully and GPU OOM errors stopped after warmup.

samir: followups (action items):
- samir: add stricter GC guardrails + alert at 60% disk (GITHUB-1345)
- irene: deploy more aggressive log-rotation for serve logger (GITHUB-1346)
- alex: evaluate moving modelcache to a separate volume per node or attach bigger ephemeral volumes to pool (INFRA-789)
- priya: customer comms + post-incident report timeline (INC-2026-3112345678)

priya: paging clear? should we close incident?

oncall: I'll keep it open for 2 hours to ensure stability, then close. Good job team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident auto-note: incident 3112345678 created by priya at 3112345678, status: ongoing, severity: Sev2."
